description.text:
Your Responsibilities
 Contribute to the design, development, and implementation of ADAS features.
 Collaborate on the creation and refinement of algorithms that interpret sensor data (e.g., cameras, radar, LiDAR) to enable accurate detection, classification, and decision-making for ADAS functionalities.
 Work closely with software engineers to integrate ADAS algorithms into the overall vehicle software architecture, ensuring seamless functionality and performance.
 Conduct thorough testing, validation, and verification of ADAS features through simulation tools and real-world testing to ensure reliability, accuracy, and safety under various conditions.
 Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and propose optimizations to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of ADAS functionalities.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, system architects, and vehicle dynamics specialists to ensure holistic integration and performance of ADAS systems.
You Have
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Advanced degree preferred.
 Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or similar languages used in algorithm development for ADAS.
 Experience with embedded systems.
 Strong understanding of sensor technologies, signal processing, and sensor fusion techniques used in automotive applications.
 Knowledge of machine learning, computer vision, or artificial intelligence applied to ADAS.
Great to Have
 3 years of experience in ADAS development, automotive engineering, or related fields.
 Experience with real-time operating systems, and software development for automotive applications.
 Experience with relevant tools and frameworks used in ADAS development and testing (e.g., MATLAB, Simulink, ROS, etc.).
 Track record of successful implementation or contributions to commercial ADAS systems.
 Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
 Familiarity with automotive industry standards, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements related to ADAS.
